packs.name: Manager pack
packs.audience: Managers and team leads who need the week's commitments, meetings and pipeline on one desk.
packs.summary: Eight cards for the weekly management rhythm: calendar, load, meetings, promises, pipeline, mail, research and the morning command card.

packs.name: CFO pack
packs.audience: Finance leaders tracking revenue, aging, budget, scorecards and close risk.
packs.summary: Eight cards for the finance desk: revenue, receivables, budget burn, KPIs, reconciliation, renewals, audit and the weekly review command card.

packs.name: Ops pack
packs.audience: Operations and support leads watching follow-ups, sources, notes and plugin health.
packs.summary: Eight cards for the operations desk: promises, waiting-on, source ledger, meeting actions, health, updates, compliance and the weekly review command card.
